errors.text: The proposed Miedema-plus-descriptor regression is unrelated to the target replacement of liquid-phase EAM by an MTP and thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation.

It treats mixing enthalpy and configurational/vibrational entropy descriptors as sufficient to determine melting, but melting requires the free-energy difference between explicitly defined solid and liquid phases. Miedema mixing enthalpy is not the enthalpy of fusion.

The expression ΔSfus = ΔSconf + ΔSvib is incomplete and potentially incorrect because entropy of fusion is the difference between liquid and solid entropies and may include electronic, anharmonic, chemical-ordering, and other contributions. The target specifically finds important electronic and solid-state SRO corrections.
The claimed ±5% melting-temperature accuracy and superiority to CALPHAD are not supported by the cited evidence.
The requested heat-capacity prediction is not actually addressed.
